attempts.summary: On node1, created datauser and a dedicated XFS filesystem (loopback image /var/lib/srv-data-backing/data.img, 512M) mounted at /srv/data via /etc/fstab with usrquota. Set a kernel-enforced XFS user quota of 100MB (bsoft=bhard=100m) for datauser. Verified enforcement: 60MB write succeeds, 150MB write is hard-blocked by the filesystem with EDQUOT at exactly 100MB used. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a graceful reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed boot_id changed (1e0cb179... -> 973e294e...), and re-verified post-restart that the fstab mount, datauser account, and quota enforcement all recovered correctly (repeated the 150MB write test post-reboot, again blocked at 100MB).
